verses.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’el- mō·šeh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: FALOU mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: דַּבֵּ֞ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לֵאמֹר֒ נֶ֗פֶשׁ כִּֽי־ תֶחֱטָ֤א בִשְׁגָגָה֙ מִכֹּל֙ מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר לֹ֣א תֵעָשֶׂ֑ינָה וְעָשָׂ֕ה מֵאַחַ֖ת מֵהֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rå̄·ʾēl lê·mōr ne·p̄eš kî- ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh mik·kōl miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh wə·‘ā·śāh mê·’a·ḥaṯ mê·hên·nāh
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites . . . to do as follows with one who sins unintentionally against any of the LORD’s commandments and does . . . what is forbidden by them
verses.literalPt: Fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Quando uma alma pecar, por ignorância, contra alguns dos mandamentos do SENHOR, acerca do que não se deve fazer, e proceder contra algum deles;

verses.original: אִ֣ם הַכֹּהֵ֧ן הַמָּשִׁ֛יחַ יֶחֱטָ֖א לְאַשְׁמַ֣ת הָעָ֑ם וְהִקְרִ֡יב עַ֣ל חַטָּאתוֹ֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטָ֜א פַּ֣ר בֶּן־ בָּקָ֥ר תָּמִ֛ים לַיהוָ֖ה לְחַטָּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: ’im hak·kō·hên ham·mā·šî·aḥ ye·ḥĕ·ṭā lə·’aš·maṯ hā·‘ām wə·hiq·rîḇ ‘al ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā par ben- bā·qār tā·mîm Yah·weh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ
verses.literal: If the anointed priest sins bringing guilt on the people he must bring to the LORD a young bull without blemish . . . . . . as a sin offering for the sin he has committed
verses.literalPt: Se o sacerdote ungido pecar para escândalo do povo, oferecerá ao SENHOR, pelo seu pecado, que cometeu, um novilho sem defeito, por expiação do pecado.

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ פֶּ֛תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְסָמַ֤ךְ אֶת־ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַפָּ֔ר וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- hap·pār ’el- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al- rōš hap·pār wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hap·pār lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: He must bring the bull to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting before the LORD lay his hand on the bull’s head and slaughter it before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E trará o novilho à porta da tenda da congregação, perante o SENHOR, e porá a sua mão sobre a cabeça do novilho, e degolará o novilho perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֛ח הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר וְהֵבִ֥יא אֹת֖וֹ אֶל־ אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên ham·mā·šî·aḥ mid·dam hap·pār wə·hê·ḇî ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then the anointed priest shall take some of the bull’s blood and bring it into the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote ungido tomará do sangue do novilho, e o trará à tenda da congregação;

verses.original: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶת־ אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ בַּדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֨ה מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֶת־ פְּנֵ֖י פָּרֹ֥כֶת הַקֹּֽדֶשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭā·ḇal hak·kō·hên ’eṯ- ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw bad·dām wə·hiz·zāh min- had·dām še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’eṯ- pə·nê pā·rō·ḵeṯ haq·qō·ḏeš
verses.literal: The priest is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of it seven times before the LORD . . . in front of the veil of the sanctuary
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote molhará o seu dedo no sangue, e daquele sangue espargirá sete vezes perante o SENHOR diante do véu do santuário.

verses.original: וְנָתַן֩ הַכֹּהֵ֨ן מִן־ הַדָּ֜ם עַל־ קַ֠רְנוֹת מִזְבַּ֨ח קְטֹ֤רֶת הַסַּמִּים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת׀ כָּל־ דַּ֣ם הַפָּ֗ר יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan hak·kō·hên min- had·dām ‘al- qar·nō·wṯ miz·baḥ qə·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’êṯ kāl- dam hap·pār yiš·pōḵ ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: The priest must then put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting And he is to pour out the rest of the bull’s blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Também o sacerdote porá daquele sangue sobre as pontas do altar do incenso aromático, perante o SENHOR que está na tenda da congregação; e todo o restante do sangue do novilho derramará à base do altar do holocausto, que está à porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֵ֛לֶב פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ הַֽמְכַסֶּ֣ה עַל־ הַקֶּ֔רֶב וְאֵת֙ כָּל־ הַחֵ֔לֶב אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַקֶּֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥê·leḇ par ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ yā·rîm mim·men·nū ’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ham·ḵas·seh ‘al- haq·qe·reḇ wə·’êṯ kāl- ha·ḥê·leḇ ’ă·šer ‘al- haq·qe·reḇ
verses.literal: Then he shall remove all the fat from the bull of the sin offering the fat that covers the entrails all the fat that is on them
verses.literalPt: E tirará toda a gordura do novilho da expiação; a gordura que cobre a fressura, e toda a gordura que está sobre a fressura,

verses.original: וְאֵת֙ שְׁתֵּ֣י הַכְּלָיֹ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַחֵ֙לֶב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ הַכְּסָלִ֑ים וְאֶת־ הַיֹּתֶ֙רֶת֙ עַל־ הַכָּבֵ֔ד עַל־ הַכְּלָי֖וֹת יְסִירֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ šə·tê hak·kə·lā·yōṯ wə·’eṯ- ha·ḥê·leḇ ’ă·šer ‘ă·lê·hen ’ă·šer ‘al- hak·kə·sā·lîm wə·’eṯ- hay·yō·ṯe·reṯ ‘al- hak·kā·ḇêḏ ‘al- hak·kə·lā·yō·wṯ yə·sî·ren·nāh
verses.literal: both kidneys with the fat on them near the loins and the lobe of the liver which he is to remove with the kidneys
verses.literalPt: E os dois rins, e a gordura que está sobre eles, que está junto aos lombos, e o redenho de sobre o fígado, com os rins, tirá-los-á,

verses.original: כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר יוּרַ֔ם מִשּׁ֖וֹר זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְהִקְטִירָם֙ הַכֹּהֵ֔ן עַ֖ל מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ka·’ă·šer yū·ram miš·šō·wr ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm wə·hiq·ṭî·rām hak·kō·hên ‘al miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: just as the fat is removed from the ox of the peace offering Then the priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering
verses.literalPt: Como se tira do boi do sacrifício pacífico; e o sacerdote os queimará sobre o altar do holocausto.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ ע֤וֹר הַפָּר֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ בְּשָׂר֔וֹ עַל־ רֹאשׁ֖וֹ וְעַל־ כְּרָעָ֑יו וְקִרְבּ֖וֹ וּפִרְשֽׁוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘ō·wr hap·pār wə·’eṯ- kāl- bə·śā·rōw ‘al- rō·šōw wə·‘al- kə·rā·‘āw wə·qir·bōw ū·p̄ir·šōw
verses.literal: But the hide of the bull and all its flesh with its head . . . and legs and its entrails and dung
verses.literalPt: Mas o couro do novilho, e toda a sua carne, com a sua cabeça e as suas pernas, e as suas entranhas, e o seu esterco,

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ כָּל־ הַ֠פָּר אֶל־ מִח֨וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֜ה אֶל־ מָק֤וֹם טָהוֹר֙ אֶל־ שֶׁ֣פֶךְ הַדֶּ֔שֶׁן וְשָׂרַ֥ף אֹת֛וֹ עַל־ עֵצִ֖ים בָּאֵ֑שׁ עַל־ שֶׁ֥פֶךְ הַדֶּ֖שֶׁן יִשָּׂרֵֽף׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- kāl- hap·pār ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh ’el- mā·qō·wm ṭā·hō·wr ’el- še·p̄eḵ had·de·šen wə·śā·rap̄ ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ‘ê·ṣîm bā·’êš ‘al- še·p̄eḵ had·de·šen yiś·śā·rêp̄
verses.literal: all the rest of the bull he must take outside the camp to a ceremonially clean . . . place where the ashes are poured out and there he must burn it on a wood fire on the ash heap
verses.literalPt: Enfim, o novilho todo levará fora do arraial a um lugar limpo, onde se lança a cinza, e o queimará com fogo sobre a lenha; onde se lança a cinza se queimará.

verses.original: וְאִ֨ם כָּל־ עֲדַ֤ת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יִשְׁגּ֔וּ וְנֶעְלַ֣ם דָּבָ֔ר מֵעֵינֵ֖י הַקָּהָ֑ל וְ֠עָשׂוּ אַחַ֨ת מִכָּל־ מִצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁמוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im kāl- ‘ă·ḏaṯ yiś·rā·’êl yiš·gū wə·ne‘·lam dā·ḇār mê·‘ê·nê haq·qā·hāl wə·‘ā·śū ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kāl miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh wə·’ā·šê·mū
verses.literal: Now if the whole congregation of Israel strays unintentionally and the matter escapes the notice of the assembly so that they violate any . . . of the LORD’s commandments and incur guilt by doing what is forbidden . . .
verses.literalPt: Mas, se toda a congregação de Israel pecar por ignorância, e o erro for oculto aos olhos do povo, e se fizerem contra alguns dos mandamentos do SENHOR, aquilo que não se deve fazer, e forem culpados,

verses.original: וְנֽוֹדְעָה֙ הַֽחַטָּ֔את אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטְא֖וּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וְהִקְרִ֨יבוּ הַקָּהָ֜ל פַּ֤ר בֶּן־ בָּקָר֙ לְחַטָּ֔את וְהֵבִ֣יאוּ אֹת֔וֹ לִפְנֵ֖י אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·wḏ·‘āh ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭə·’ū ‘ā·le·hā wə·hiq·rî·ḇū haq·qā·hāl par ben- bā·qār lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·hê·ḇî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw lip̄·nê ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: when they become aware of the sin they have committed . . . then the assembly . . . must bring a young bull as a sin offering and present it before the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E quando o pecado que cometeram for conhecido, então a congregação oferecerá um novilho, por expiação do pecado, e o trará diante da tenda da congregação,

verses.original: וְ֠סָמְכוּ זִקְנֵ֨י הָעֵדָ֧ה אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֛ם עַל־ רֹ֥אשׁ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְשָׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הַפָּ֖ר לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·mə·ḵū ziq·nê hā·‘ê·ḏāh ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem ‘al- rōš hap·pār lip̄·nê Yah·weh wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hap·pār lip̄·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: The elders of the congregation are to lay their hands on the bull’s head before the LORD and it shall be slaughtered before the LORD
verses.literalPt: E os anciãos da congregação porão as suas mãos sobre a cabeça do novilho perante o SENHOR; e degolar-se-á o novilho perante o SENHOR.

verses.original: וְהֵבִ֛יא הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַמָּשִׁ֖יחַ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֑ר אֶל־ אֹ֖הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·ḇî hak·kō·hên ham·mā·šî·aḥ mid·dam hap·pār ’el- ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: Then the anointed priest is to bring some of the bull’s blood into the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: Então o sacerdote ungido trará do sangue do novilho à tenda da congregação,

verses.original: וְטָבַ֧ל הַכֹּהֵ֛ן אֶצְבָּע֖וֹ מִן־ הַדָּ֑ם וְהִזָּ֞ה שֶׁ֤בַע פְּעָמִים֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֵ֖ת פְּנֵ֥י הַפָּרֹֽכֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṭā·ḇal hak·kō·hên ’eṣ·bā·‘ōw min- had·dām wə·hiz·zāh še·ḇa‘ pə·‘ā·mîm lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’êṯ pə·nê hap·pā·rō·ḵeṯ
verses.literal: and he is to dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD . . . in front of the veil
verses.literalPt: E o sacerdote molhará o seu dedo naquele sangue, e o espargirá sete vezes perante o SENHOR, diante do véu.

verses.original: וּמִן־ הַדָּ֞ם יִתֵּ֣ן׀ עַל־ קַרְנֹ֣ת הַמִּזְבֵּ֗חַ אֲשֶׁר֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֣ת כָּל־ הַדָּ֗ם יִשְׁפֹּךְ֙ אֶל־ יְסוֹד֙ מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ū·min- had·dām yit·tên ‘al- qar·nōṯ ham·miz·bê·aḥ ’ă·šer lip̄·nê Yah·weh ’ă·šer bə·’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’êṯ kāl- had·dām yiš·pōḵ ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh ’ă·šer- pe·ṯaḥ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ
verses.literal: He is also to put some of the blood on the horns of the altar that is before the LORD in the Tent of Meeting and he must pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting
verses.literalPt: E daquele sangue porá sobre as pontas do altar, que está perante a face do SENHOR, na tenda da congregação; e todo o restante do sangue derramará à base do altar do holocausto, que está diante da porta da tenda da congregação.

verses.original: וְאֵ֥ת כָּל־ חֶלְבּ֖וֹ יָרִ֣ים מִמֶּ֑נּוּ וְהִקְטִ֖יר הַמִּזְבֵּֽחָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ kāl- ḥel·bōw yā·rîm mim·men·nū wə·hiq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh
verses.literal: And he is to remove all the fat from it and burn it on the altar
verses.literalPt: E tirará dele toda a sua gordura, e queimá-la-á sobre o altar;

verses.original: וְעָשָׂ֣ה לַפָּ֔ר כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְפַ֣ר הַֽחַטָּ֔את כֵּ֖ן יַעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֧ר עֲלֵהֶ֛ם הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·śāh lap·pār ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·p̄ar ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ kên ya·‘ă·śeh- lōw wə·ḵip·per ‘ă·lê·hem hak·kō·hên wə·nis·laḥ lā·hem
verses.literal: He shall offer this bull just as he did the bull for the sin offering in this way the priest will make atonement on their behalf and they will be forgiven . . .
verses.literalPt: E fará a este novilho, como fez ao novilho da expiação; assim lhe fará, e o sacerdote por eles fará propiciação, e lhes será perdoado o pecado.

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא אֶת־ הַפָּ֗ר אֶל־ מִחוּץ֙ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה וְשָׂרַ֣ף אֹת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר שָׂרַ֔ף אֵ֖ת הַפָּ֣ר הָרִאשׁ֑וֹן חַטַּ֥את הַקָּהָ֖ל הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- hap·pār ’el- mi·ḥūṣ lam·ma·ḥă·neh wə·śā·rap̄ ’ō·ṯōw ka·’ă·šer śā·rap̄ ’êṯ hap·pār hā·ri·šō·wn ḥaṭ·ṭaṯ haq·qā·hāl hū
verses.literal: Then he is to take the bull outside the camp and burn it just as he burned the first bull It is the sin offering for the assembly
verses.literalPt: Depois levará o novilho fora do arraial, e o queimará como queimou o primeiro novilho; é expiação do pecado da congregação.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָשִׂ֖יא יֶֽחֱטָ֑א וְעָשָׂ֡ה אַחַ֣ת מִכָּל־ מִצְוֺת֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהָ֜יו אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֛ינָה בִּשְׁגָגָ֖ה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer nā·śî ye·ḥĕ·ṭā wə·‘ā·śāh ’a·ḥaṯ mik·kāl miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hāw ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh biš·ḡā·ḡāh wə·’ā·šêm
verses.literal: When a leader sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited by any of the commandments of the LORD his God . . . he incurs guilt
verses.literalPt: Quando um príncipe pecar, e por ignorância proceder contra algum dos mandamentos do SENHOR seu Deus, naquilo que não se deve fazer, e assim for culpado;

verses.original: אֽוֹ־ הוֹדַ֤ע אֵלָיו֙ חַטָּאת֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָ֖א בָּ֑הּ וְהֵבִ֧יא אֶת־ קָרְבָּנ֛וֹ שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים זָכָ֥ר תָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw- hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ê·lāw ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā bāh wə·hê·ḇî ’eṯ- qā·rə·bā·nōw śə·‘îr ‘iz·zîm zā·ḵār tā·mîm
verses.literal: When he becomes aware . . . of the sin he has committed he must bring an unblemished male goat . . . . . . as his offering
verses.literalPt: Ou se o pecado que cometeu lhe for notificado, então trará pela sua oferta um bode tirado das cabras, macho sem defeito;

verses.original: וְסָמַ֤ךְ יָדוֹ֙ עַל־ רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשָׁחַ֣ט אֹת֔וֹ בִּמְק֛וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ יִשְׁחַ֥ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָ֖ה לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה חַטָּ֖את הֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ yā·ḏōw ‘al- rōš haś·śā·‘îr wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯōw bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer- yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh lip̄·nê Yah·weh ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ hū
verses.literal: He is to lay his hand on the head of the goat and slaughter it at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered before the LORD It is a sin offering
verses.literalPt: E porá a sua mão sobre a cabeça do bode, e o degolará no lugar onde se degola o holocausto, perante a face do SENHOR; expiação do pecado é.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ דָּמ֣וֹ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- dā·mōw yiš·pōḵ ’el- yə·sō·wḏ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar
verses.literalPt: Depois o sacerdote com o seu dedo tomará do sangue da expiação, e o porá sobre as pontas do altar do holocausto; então o restante do seu sangue derramará à base do altar do holocausto.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבּוֹ֙ יַקְטִ֣יר הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה כְּחֵ֖לֶב זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן מֵחַטָּאת֖וֹ וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥel·bōw yaq·ṭîr ham·miz·bê·ḥāh kə·ḥê·leḇ ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên mê·ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: He must burn all its fat on the altar like the fat of the peace offerings thus the priest will make atonement for that man’s sin and he will be forgiven
verses.literalPt: Também queimará sobre o altar toda a sua gordura como gordura do sacrifício pacífico; assim o sacerdote por ele fará expiação do seu pecado, e lhe será perdoado.

verses.original: וְאִם־ נֶ֧פֶשׁ אַחַ֛ת תֶּחֱטָ֥א בִשְׁגָגָ֖ה מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֠עֲשֹׂתָהּ אַחַ֨ת מִמִּצְוֺ֧ת יְהוָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ תֵעָשֶׂ֖ינָה וְאָשֵֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ne·p̄eš ’a·ḥaṯ te·ḥĕ·ṭā ḇiš·ḡā·ḡāh mê·‘am hā·’ā·reṣ ba·‘ă·śō·ṯāh ’a·ḥaṯ mim·miṣ·wōṯ Yah·weh ’ă·šer lō- ṯê·‘ā·śe·nāh wə·’ā·šêm
verses.literal: And if one . . . of the common people sins unintentionally and does what is prohibited . . . by any of the LORD’s commandments he incurs guilt
verses.literalPt: E, se qualquer pessoa do povo da terra pecar por ignorância, fazendo contra algum dos mandamentos do SENHOR, aquilo que não se deve fazer, e assim for culpada;

verses.original: א֚וֹ הוֹדַ֣ע אֵלָ֔יו חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָטָ֑א וְהֵבִ֨יא קָרְבָּנ֜וֹ שְׂעִירַ֤ת עִזִּים֙ תְּמִימָ֣ה נְקֵבָ֔ה עַל־ חַטָּאת֖וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר חָטָֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw hō·w·ḏa‘ ’ê·lāw ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā wə·hê·ḇî qā·rə·bā·nōw śə·‘î·raṯ ‘iz·zîm tə·mî·māh nə·qê·ḇāh ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer ḥā·ṭā
verses.literal: When he becomes aware . . . of the sin he has committed he must bring an unblemished female goat . . . as his offering for that sin . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Ou se o pecado que cometeu lhe for notificado, então trará pela sua oferta uma cabra sem defeito, pelo seu pecado que cometeu,

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַט֙ אֶת־ הַ֣חַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֖וֹם הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: He is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it at the place of the burnt offering
verses.literalPt: E porá a sua mão sobre a cabeça da oferta da expiação do pecado, e a degolará no lugar do holocausto.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֤ן מִדָּמָהּ֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dā·māh bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- dā·māh yiš·pōḵ ’el- yə·sō·wḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of its blood with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of the blood at the base of the altar
verses.literalPt: Depois o sacerdote com o seu dedo tomará do seu sangue, e o porá sobre as pontas do altar do holocausto; e todo o restante do seu sangue derramará à base do altar;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣הּ יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר הוּסַ֣ר חֵלֶב֮ מֵעַ֣ל זֶ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֤יר הַכֹּהֵן֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה לְרֵ֥יחַ נִיחֹ֖חַ לַיהוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֥ר עָלָ֛יו הַכֹּהֵ֖ן וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥel·bāh yā·sîr ka·’ă·šer hū·sar ḥê·leḇ mê·‘al ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ham·miz·bê·ḥāh lə·rê·aḥ nî·ḥō·aḥ Yah·weh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: Then he is to remove all the fat just as it is removed from the peace offering and the priest is to burn it on the altar as a pleasing aroma to the LORD In this way the priest will make atonement for him and he will be forgiven
verses.literalPt: E tirará toda a gordura, como se tira a gordura do sacrifício pacífico; e o sacerdote a queimará sobre o altar, por cheiro suave ao SENHOR; e o sacerdote fará expiação por ela, e ser-lhe-á perdoado o pecado.

verses.original: וְאִם־ כֶּ֛בֶשׂ יָבִ֥יא קָרְבָּנ֖וֹ לְחַטָּ֑את נְקֵבָ֥ה תְמִימָ֖ה יְבִיאֶֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ke·ḇeś yā·ḇî qā·rə·bā·nōw lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ nə·qê·ḇāh ṯə·mî·māh yə·ḇî·’en·nāh
verses.literal: If, however he brings a lamb as a sin offering he must bring an unblemished female
verses.literalPt: Mas, se pela sua oferta trouxer uma cordeira para expiação do pecado, sem defeito trará.

verses.original: וְסָמַךְ֙ אֶת־ יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַֽחַטָּ֑את וְשָׁחַ֤ט אֹתָהּ֙ לְחַטָּ֔את בִּמְק֕וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשְׁחַ֖ט אֶת־ הָעֹלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·sā·maḵ ’eṯ- yā·ḏōw ‘al rōš ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ wə·šā·ḥaṭ ’ō·ṯāh lə·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bim·qō·wm ’ă·šer yiš·ḥaṭ ’eṯ- hā·‘ō·lāh
verses.literal: And he is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered
verses.literalPt: E porá a sua mão sobre a cabeça da oferta da expiação do pecado, e a degolará por oferta pelo pecado, no lugar onde se degola o holocausto.

verses.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֤ם הַֽחַטָּאת֙ בְּאֶצְבָּע֔וֹ וְנָתַ֕ן עַל־ קַרְנֹ֖ת מִזְבַּ֣ח הָעֹלָ֑ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ דָּמָ֣הּ יִשְׁפֹּ֔ךְ אֶל־ יְס֖וֹד הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ hak·kō·hên mid·dam ha·ḥaṭ·ṭāṯ bə·’eṣ·bā·‘ōw wə·nā·ṯan ‘al- qar·nōṯ miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- dā·māh yiš·pōḵ ’el- yə·sō·wḏ ham·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the priest is to take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering and pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar
verses.literalPt: Depois o sacerdote com o seu dedo tomará do sangue da expiação do pecado, e o porá sobre as pontas do altar do holocausto; então todo o restante do seu sangue derramará na base do altar.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ כָּל־ חֶלְבָּ֣ה יָסִ֗יר כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר יוּסַ֥ר חֵֽלֶב־ הַכֶּשֶׂב֮ מִזֶּ֣בַח הַשְּׁלָמִים֒ וְהִקְטִ֨יר הַכֹּהֵ֤ן אֹתָם֙ הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חָה עַ֖ל אִשֵּׁ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִפֶּ֨ר עָלָ֧יו הַכֹּהֵ֛ן עַל־ חַטָּאת֥וֹ אֲשֶׁר־ חָטָ֖א וְנִסְלַ֥ח לֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- kāl- ḥel·bāh yā·sîr ka·’ă·šer yū·sar ḥê·leḇ- hak·ke·śeḇ miz·ze·ḇaḥ haš·šə·lā·mîm wə·hiq·ṭîr hak·kō·hên ’ō·ṯām ham·miz·bê·ḥāh ‘al ’iš·šê Yah·weh wə·ḵip·per ‘ā·lāw hak·kō·hên ‘al- ḥaṭ·ṭā·ṯōw ’ă·šer- ḥā·ṭā wə·nis·laḥ lōw
verses.literal: And he shall remove all the fat just as the fat of the lamb is removed from the peace offerings and he shall burn it on the altar along with the food offerings to the LORD In this way the priest will make atonement for him for the sin he has committed and he will be forgiven
verses.literalPt: E tirará toda a sua gordura, como se tira a gordura do cordeiro do sacrifício pacífico; e o sacerdote a queimará sobre o altar, em cima das ofertas queimadas do SENHOR; assim o sacerdote por ele fará expiação dos seus pecados que cometeu, e ele será perdoado.
